assessment_before_owner_decision.note: Original BM25S requires NumPy without an exact pin. The inspected NumPy 2.2.6 source distribution includes libdivide under Zlib; LICENSES_bundled.txt explicitly classifies it as bundled library code, unlike the build-only libraries it separately identifies. Zlib is permissive and royalty-free, but absent from the inherited closed allowlist. No exception or policy change was made. This finding does not characterize every other compatible NumPy version or prove commercial incompatibility. No BM25S or NumPy installation/build was performed. Partial source extraction first hit workspace ENOSPC; review continued directly from the verified source archive.
